article.title: Online Gambling Detection Systems: A Systematic Review.
article.authors: Ajhari AA, Aji RF, Mantau AJ
article.abstract: Illegal online gambling increasingly exploits websites, mobile applications, social media, messaging services, and decentralized financial infrastructure, and operators actively evade automated filtering. This review synthesizes how online gambling detection systems (OGDS) are applied, integrated, and evaluated, and which limitations constrain their deployment.
